# What `serve/server.py` does

`serve/server.py` is the HTTP front door of Strata: it is the process that listens on a port (default 8080) and speaks the OpenAI Chat Completions and Anthropic Messages APIs to clients, while talking to the C++ engine over a pipe. It is pure Python and touches no GPU — its job is to translate text into token ids, hand them to an engine, and stream the engine's token ids back as text deltas.
